summary: Independently reproduced the remaining counterexamples in review PR https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/842 against candidate PR https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/736 at 2aea7cad31ab4ef5547ee7a23c6425220e41a65f. The candidate validly maps the divisible 42-token tier to seven width-6 rows and fixes the separately reproduced DSV4 overlapping metadata copy, but 41-, 43-, and 47-token tiers remain genuinely ragged and incompatible with the issue-described equal-block Engram assertion. The checkout has no Engram implementation, so the missing layout-aware Engram correction and real hash outputs cannot be produced or validated here.

tests.what_was_measured: The base produced 42 -> [6,6,5,5,5,5,5,5]; candidate geometry calculations produced unequal 41, 43, and 47 tiers that fail the reported Engram equality contract. DSV4RawVerifyMetadata.copy_ raised the reported shared-storage RuntimeError on an AMD Instinct MI355X. Raw output: reports/j-e1aa80cf6ae9/raw/failing-before.txt

14 tests and 8 subtests passed, including the 42-token slot correction, explicit 41/43/47 ragged boundary layouts, and alias-safe raw verify/decode metadata copies. Raw output: reports/j-e1aa80cf6ae9/raw/focused-tests.txt

Actual helper outputs matched the expected 41/42/43/47/48 layouts, and overlapping DSV4 raw verify and decode copies preserved independent reference tensors on AMD Instinct MI355X. Raw output: reports/j-e1aa80cf6ae9/raw/passing-after.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: The failing-before and passing-after metadata-copy checks used AMD Instinct MI355X device tensors with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015.
remaining_limitations: The prepared base and exact candidate commit contain no EngramHasher, python/sglang/srt/layers/engram.py, or other Engram implementation. No layout-aware Engram source correction or per-request hash-output comparison is possible from this checkout.

The issue's full first-forward path with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash was not run. The model weights, Engram architecture, four-node NVIDIA GB10 TP4/EP4 deployment, and CUDA graph execution are unavailable on the assigned single ROCm GPU.
The retained capture-slot change fixes divisible tiers such as 42 tokens but intentionally preserves compact-ragged semantics; it does not make the absent Engram consumer layout-aware.
The retained DSV4 copy change is validated only at the isolated real-device metadata mechanism, not in a DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash serving run.
No FlyDSL C++ or LLVM source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
